messages:
Alex V: Proposal: ship a "deprecation concierge" preview flow. Not full soft-exit yet — a non-invasive simulation + small advice panel in console so tenants can see routing, costs, and which routes will be impacted. Thoughts?
Priya D: Agree. Keep it read-only at first. Preview should show simulated v2 preference, estimated tokens shifted, and any routes that would hit a legacy cap. Also add deterministic sampling so results are reproducible.
Marco G: For sampling: hash(route_id + date) % 100 < sample_pct. Default sample_pct=5. API: POST /internal/concierge/{route_id}/preview {window_hours:24,sample_pct:5,dry_run:true}. Return compact summary only.
Console UX: UI idea: small inline pill on route page: "Preview migration (concierge)" -> modal with three columns: Current | Concierge Preview | Delta. Include quick actions: Request Extension, Pin Legacy (creates audit), Ask SE. Keep language non-alarming.
Alex V: Good. Enforcement: if preview shows routes that would exceed legacy cap, surface them and include header examples for real requests: `X-V1-Grace-Remaining: 12345` and a standard error body for actual enforcement `HTTP 429 {"error":"v1_legacy_cap_exceeded","hint":"Consider switching to v2 or request an extension via console"}`.
Marco G: Add `fallback_reason` values: `pinned`,`capacity_pressure`,`legacy_cap`. Emit `deprec.concierge.previewed` event. For actual routing events: `deprec.concierge.fallback` and `deprec.concierge.pin`.
Console UX: For the modal, show an estimated monthly cost delta and a tiny example diff of outputs (sampled). Button copy options: "Preview impact" / "Prefer legacy for this route" / "Request help".
Priya D: Telemetry: low-cardinality tags only: `concierge_cohort=control|preview|pilot`, `route_version`. Send high-cardinality logs for pin/exemption events (audit log topic). Sample full payload diffs at 0.1% and label `diff_sample=true`.
metrics-bot: Note: preview metrics may affect alerting dashboards. Recommend a separate preview series or correction factor so alerts don't fire on previews.
ops-bot: Runbook proposals: 1) If >3% of previewed tenants would hit legacy cap in a 30m window, block auto-prefers. 2) If v2 error-rate rises >0.4% absolute for preview cohort, pause rollout and page infra.
Alex V: UX-fun: include a friendly sentence in modal: "This simulation uses recent traffic to estimate impact. Results are best-effort — try a higher sample for more confidence." Also include a link "Why outputs may differ" that lists tokenizer and prompt handling differences.
Marco G: Infra: add dry-run header `X-Concierge-Sim:true` and return `X-Sim-Id` in responses. Also support `persist=true` to actually flip defaults after human approval. Include sample response schema in API docs.
Priya D: Performance concern: avoid adding tenant_id to metrics tags. Use cohort tags and route_id only when necessary. Keep per-tenant traces in logs.
billing-bot: Add estimated bill delta to modal and run nightly recalcs for previewed tenants. Show both immediate delta and projected month delta.
Console UX: For pinned legacy routes, surface an audit flow that requires justification and auto-creates a ticket for SEs. Pin should be rate-limited and show projected cost impact inline.
Alex V: Final items: events to emit `deprec.concierge.started`, `deprec.concierge.previewed`, `deprec.concierge.request_extension`, `deprec.concierge.pinned`, `deprec.concierge.exhausted`. Action owners: Marco -> API + dry-run semantics; Priya -> telemetry + sampling; Console UX -> modal + copy variants + audit flow; Ops -> runbook thresholds; Billing -> nightly recalcs.
Marco G: Deploy note: will push routing-concierge v1 to staging tonight. deploy-bot: routing-concierge v1 deployed to staging at 2024-03-12T02:14:22Z :white_check_mark:
Alex V: Thanks all. Let's run a pilot with 250 tenants next week and reconvene after 48h of samples. :thumbsup:
